note: Compact exceptions to path/marker derivation for the #218 test baseline. 'excluded' entries must reference collected node IDs (exact) or node-ID prefixes and carry a reason. 'owner_overrides' re-map the derived owner of a node ID or prefix. 'ownership_notes' record per-lane boundary justifications and proposed owners that derivation cannot decide; unresolved lanes stay null. Empty means full derivation coverage.
